gatekeeper_rules.name: BIO_GATE_1
gatekeeper_rules.title: Pre-8K Unannounced Leak w/ Named Pharma Suitor + Specific Dollar Bid (55.6% Base Rate)
gatekeeper_rules.description: Tier-1 pre-8K scoop must identify BOTH a specific Big Pharma suitor AND a concrete dollar valuation anchor ($124/sh AstraZeneca on $RYTM, $68.50 Pfizer on $GBT, $108+ Amgen on $HZNP). Eliminates generic 'exploring options' chatter ($BMRN -20%, $ALNY -15%, $VKTX -45%) and separates post-8K merger-arb topping wars ($MTSR, $AVDL).
gatekeeper_rules.hard_fail: Vague 'exploring options' chatter with no leaked dollar bid ($BMRN, $ALNY, $FOLD, $ACAD, $VKTX).

gatekeeper_rules.name: BIO_GATE_2
gatekeeper_rules.title: Commercial Rare-Disease / Pivotal Anchor + Standalone Fundamental Floor
gatekeeper_rules.description: Target must have an FDA-approved commercial rare-disease/specialty drug (or completed pivotal registrational data + >$1B cash like $RNA) so a walk-away is cushioned around -13% to -19% ($89–$95 on $RYTM via $92.13M Q3 Imcivree +79.6% YoY & $750M KKR/Blackstone facility).
gatekeeper_rules.hard_fail: Early/mid-stage binary clinical risk with no commercial revenue cushion ($VKTX -45.0%, $KD -11.2%).

gatekeeper_rules.name: BIO_GATE_3
gatekeeper_rules.title: Clean Cap Table & Unencumbered Global Commercial Rights
gatekeeper_rules.description: Target must own unencumbered worldwide rights (or have bought down royalty/partner encumbrances, like $RYTM buying down LG Chem's bivamelagon royalty to 1%).
gatekeeper_rules.hard_fail: Co-development ROFRs or heavy debt overhang that deter rival suitors ($BBIO 2023 -12.24%, $PTGX -5.27%).

gatekeeper_rules.name: BIO_GATE_4
gatekeeper_rules.title: Rejected Opening Bid / Multi-Bidder Sweetening Tension (4 of 5 Wins Sweetened)
gatekeeper_rules.description: 4 of the 5 genuine pre-8K 6-gate winners ($HZNP, $SGEN, $SAGE, $RNA) closed at a sweetened bidding-war price (+18.4% to +22.6%). Without credible 2nd-bidder tension, a 55.6% base rate cannot overcome walk-away losses near 91%–92% of the initial bid.
gatekeeper_rules.hard_fail: Solo-bidder price cut or headline chase ($SWTX $54 -> $47 = -12.96%; $MRTX $60.20 -> $58 = -3.65%).

gatekeeper_rules.name: BIO_GATE_5
gatekeeper_rules.title: Hard Ceiling <= 92% ($114.08) | Positive-EV Add Zone <= 87% ($107.88 on $RYTM)
gatekeeper_rules.description: Never pay >92.0% of the leaked valuation anchor ($114.08 hard cap on $RYTM; held $113.00 lot = 91.1% PASS, near-breakeven +0.31% EV at 55.6% base rate). Only stage fresh/additional capital at <=87.0% of anchor ($107.88 on $RYTM) where standalone EV exceeds +5.0%.

gatekeeper_rules.name: BIO_GATE_6
